text.p: A shortage of money has forced Russia's athletics federation to cancel this month's annual Goodwill meeting in St Petersburg.
"We're not holding it this year," vice-president and chief coach Vadim Zelechonok said on Wednesday. "We just don't have the money."
The meeting had been scheduled for July 8 in Russia's second city.
The cancellation could jeopardise the future of the event, the second-ranking international athletics meeting in Russia after the regular June grand prix meeting in Moscow.

The Goodwill event will not be held next year under the rules of a contract with the organisers of the Goodwill Games which are due to be held next year in New York following the 1994 Games in St Petersburg.
